## Checks

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:coverage` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tests are added or changed for this change, or this description says why none are needed
- [ ] A new or changed rule has a passing and a failing fixture in `fixtures/<rule-id>/`
- [ ] I have agreed to [`CLA.md`](../CLA.md) in a comment on this or an earlier pull request
- [ ] Prose is in British English, and the README and docs are updated for the change, or this description says why none needed it
- [ ] Any new production dependency is permissive and justified in the README
